name: Staying Healthy
overview: Scripture teaches that true health encompasses both spiritual obedience and physical well-being. Proverbs 3:1 emphasizes the importance of keeping God's commandments as a foundation for life, while Isaiah 58:11 portrays the Lord's guidance as sustaining the soul and strengthening the body, likening a healthy person to a well-watered garden. In contrast, Ezekiel 24:12 warns against the consequences of spiritual and moral corruption, which can lead to internal decay and destruction. Together, these verses reveal that staying healthy involves a heart aligned with God's law and a life nourished by His sustaining presence.
